summary: Noah Holdings Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return on Form 6-K reporting the repurchase and cancellation of 9,378,935 ordinary shares underlying 1,875,787 ADSs. The buybacks occurred on the NYSE from December 23, 2025 to May 27, 2026 at an average price of USD 2.24 per share, representing 2.66% of existing issued shares. The cancellation was effective July 7, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine share buyback disclosure under Hong Kong listing rules. Watch for the pace of future repurchases as a signal of capital return commitment.
